name: Czech QR Payments for WooCommerce
author: Miroslav Novák

sections.description:
Payment method for fast QR code bank payment from Czech banking mobile apps.
Convenient bank transfer without having to type the account number data and just scanning the QR code in customer’s mobile banking app.

Features

  • Displays the QR code on the order confirmation page
  • Sets the bank transfer variable symbol as the order number
  • Also sends email with the QR code to the client
  • Besides the QR code it shows also the bank account number and the variable symbol for manual bank transfers
  • Supports instant payments
  • Supports Gutenberg checkout blocks as well as classic shortcodes layout

There are also premium plugins available:

  • Automated payment pairing for FIO bank – Works just like this QR code payment plugin, but also automatically marks orders as paid when incoming payments are detected via the Fio Bank API. Unlike the payment gateways, there are no transaction fees.
  • Payment plugins for the payment gateways – Comgate, ThePay, PayU, GP webpay, ČSOB, GoPay, CCBill, Barion, TrustPay, Twisto, SkipPay, HomeCredit, Essox, Cofidis, Cetelem
sections.installation:
1. Visit the plugins page within your dashboard and select ‘Add New’;
  2. Search for ‘Czech QR Code Bank Payment for WooCommerce’;
  3. Activate Payment QR WooCommerce from your Plugins page;
  4. Go to Woocommerce -> Settings -> Payments -> QR code payment for Czech banks
  5. Set your bank account number or IBAN where the customers will send their payments
sections.changelog:

1.0.6

1.0.4

  • Extended PHP backward compatibility for versions starting from PHP 7.4. Plugin is compatible with PHP 7.4 – 8.4
